findings.finding: GPIO0 strap can latch the 50 MHz RMII clock on an ESP32-internal system reset (brownout reset, RTC watchdog). EN doesn't move, so the TCA9539 keeps P05/PHY_RST high and Y2 keeps clocking GPIO0; a 0 sample leaves the chip in UART download mode until power-cycled. Firmware duty C1 (drop P05 before a software restart) is not implemented.
findings.evidence: ESP32 datasheet v5.3 s3 'At system reset, the latches sample...' and s4 (RWDT does system reset, runs during flash boot); IDF v4.4.8 with CONFIG_ESP32_REV_MIN=1 -> SOC_BROWNOUT_RESET_SUPPORTED=1 -> brownout reset_enabled=true (brownout.c, soc_caps.h); TCA9539 SCPS202C VPORF 0.75-1.0 V; YSO110TR enable >=70% VDD; docs/review-3/sims/digital/strap_check.py FAIL core GPIO0 sysrst; no shutdown handler in firmware/components.
findings.reference_design: WT32-ETH01 (GPIO0 clock in) has field reports of booting into download mode; Olimex ESP32-POE uses GPIO17 clock out (not possible with WROVER PSRAM); Espressif HDG recommends a reset supervisor on CHIP_PU for unstable supplies.
findings.fix: Add TLV803SDBZR (LCSC C132016, SOT-23, open-drain, 2.93 V, 200 ms) on ESP_EN: VDD=+3V3, RESET#=ESP_EN, GND; keep R30/C32 and Q4. Any dip that would brown out the ESP32 (2.43 V) pulls EN low first, resetting U17 so R45 turns Y2 off. Firmware: implement C1 with esp_register_shutdown_handler writing P05 low + 1 ms.
findings.margin: today none on a system reset; after the fix 0.38 V between supervisor trip (min 2.86 V) and BOD level 0 (~2.48 V max)

findings.finding: LAN8720A RXER/PHYAD0 (pin 10) is unconnected, internal pull-down -> SMI address 0. squeezelite-esp32 ee1720c network_driver_LAN8720.c hard-codes phy_config.phy_addr = 1; IDF v4.4.8 lan87xx_init only auto-detects for ESP_ETH_PHY_ADDR_AUTO, so it reads 0xFFFF and fails 'wrong chip ID'. Ethernet never comes up on Plus/Ultra.
findings.evidence: Microchip DS00002165C pin table 'PHYAD0 VIS (PD)', s3.7.1 default 0b; squeezelite network_driver_LAN8720.c line 15; IDF v4.4.8 esp_eth_phy_lan87xx.c lines 487-499; docs/review-3/sims/digital/fw_pinmap.py FAIL.
findings.reference_design: WT32-ETH01 straps PHYAD0 high (addr 1, what squeezelite assumes); Olimex ESP32-POE addr 0.
findings.fix: Add R68 10k (C25744, 0402) U9 pin 10 -> +3V3 (VDDIO, DS Note 3-3) for address 1; also patch network_driver_LAN8720.c to phy_addr = -1 (auto) so either strap works.

findings.finding: No firmware drives Ultra's front board: DISPLAY_CONFIG/SPI_CONFIG empty for Ultra, the TCA9535 at 0x27 is never probed or read (EXP_ADDRS 0x20,0x74-77; Ultra buttons = -1), so the LCD stays blank, ENC_SW/BTN1-3 and the RGB LED are dead, and the uncleared TCA9535 INT (ENC_A/B also on its P00/P01) holds EXP_INT/GPIO39 low after the first knob turn, leaving the knob on a 10 ms poll (max ~25 detents/s).
findings.evidence: firmware/board/ultra/sdkconfig.defaults lines 206-207; hifi_board_core.h EXP_ADDRS; board_core.c controls() .buttons {-1,-1,-1,-1}; ultra-front.net U1 pins 1,4,5.
findings.reference_design: squeezelite-esp32 boards with SPI displays set display_config (e.g. SPI,driver=ST7789,...) and spi_config in their Kconfig defaults.
findings.fix: Firmware: set Ultra DISPLAY_CONFIG/SPI_CONFIG (clk=32, mosi=33, dc=15, cs=-1, mode=3, the panel's driver/size, backlight via expander P06); probe 0x27, configure P10-P13 as outputs, pulse LCD_RST 10 ms, read its inputs in controls() each pass (clears INT), map ENC_SW/BTN1-3.

findings.finding: Expander P17 is TAP_SEL_IO on the board, but firmware calls it LCD_CS and leaves it an input (EXP_CFG1 0xFF); duty C6 (speaker taps) not implemented.
findings.evidence: hifi_board_core.h comment and EXP_CFG1; core.net U17 pin 20; fw_pinmap.py FAIL.
findings.fix: Add EXP_TAP_SEL 15, EXP_CFG1 0x7F, drive it in the capture path; fix the comment.

findings.finding: Firmware constants lag the board: LINE_DIVIDER 2.0 vs R30/R31 15k/10k = 2.5; HIFI_HAS_TAPS 0 but the taps are fitted; PIN_AMP_SDZ comment says 100k (R54 is 10k).
findings.margin: captures 1.9 dB low on line in

findings.finding: No ESD protection on USB D+/D-: CH340B pins 5/6 go straight to the USB-C. Core has USBLC6-2SC6. A dead CH340 removes the USB recovery path (OTA still works).
findings.evidence: lite-main.net USB_DP/USB_DM nodes; WCH CH340 DS V3D gives no ESD rating.
findings.reference_design: core U2 USBLC6-2SC6; most CP210x/CH340 dev boards rely on the bridge's own ESD.
findings.fix: Add USBLC6-2SC6 (C2687116) at J1: 1/6 USB_DP, 3/4 USB_DM, 2 GND, 5 +5V.

findings.finding: CH340B RST# (pin 7) unconnected on Lite U6 and core U8 is OK: WCH datasheet V3D pin table 'CH340B: External reset input, active low, built-in pull-up resistor'; IUP 3/70/200 uA at 3.3 V (16k-1.1M equivalent), VIL max 0.8 V; chip has its own POR (VR 2.4-2.8 V). A reset only drops the CH340's USB session, never the ESP32.
findings.evidence: WCH CH340 datasheet V3D pin table, s6.3, s5 'CH340B also provides an active low-level external reset input'; netlists: pin 7 unconnected, no trace.
findings.reference_design: WCH application circuit leaves RST# open.
findings.fix: None needed. Optional DNP 100 nF pin 7 to GND.
findings.margin: internal pull-up holds it at VCC; no trace to pick up noise

findings.finding: CH340B V3 pin 4 has no local decoupling cap of its own; only C33 at pin 16 on the opposite side of the SOP-16 (Lite has C24 at pin 4).
findings.evidence: WCH CH340 DS V3D s7: C8 0.1 uF on V3 and C9 0.1 uF on VCC, as close as possible.
findings.reference_design: WCH reference: separate 0.1 uF at V3 and VCC.
findings.fix: Add 100 nF (C1525, 0402) U8 pin 4 to GND.
findings.margin: works on the shared rail; thin

findings.finding: No copper under either antenna (DIGITAL-19 holds), but copper starts 2.25 mm (Lite) and 0.85 mm (core) beside the antenna vs Espressif's 15 mm.
findings.evidence: hwde check_antenna on /tmp copies: antenna_side_clearance warnings only; end inside 0.64 mm (Lite), 0.0 mm (core).
findings.fix: Keep round-1 disposition (RSSI check at bring-up; WROVER-IE contingency).
findings.margin: keepout clean; side clearance below guideline

findings.finding: TCA9535 has no RESET: its outputs (LCD_RST, LEDs) survive an ESP32 reset, and its INT is wired-OR onto core EXP_INT; ENC_A/B duplicated on its P00/P01 raise INT on every knob turn.
findings.evidence: ultra-front root.py U1_PINS; core.net J3 pin 14.
findings.fix: Firmware re-inits and reads 0x27 every control pass (see R3-DIGITAL-3); optional: drop the front's ENC_A/ENC_B to U1 P00/P01 (core reads them).

findings.finding: LAN8720A nRST low level through R67: 50 uA typ internal PU x 10k = 0.50 V (0.61 V with the expander pin hi-Z, 12.2k) vs VILT 1.41 V typ at 3.3 V; rises 6.9 ms after OE, Y2 starts <= 3 ms, tpurstd 25 ms met.
findings.evidence: DS00002165C Table 5-5, Table 5-9; YSO110TR t_str 3 ms.
findings.reference_design: Microchip: nRST driven by MCU GPIO.

findings.finding: CH224A I2C table lists VIH max 3.3 V; the bus pulls to +3V3 = 3.33 V. The same datasheet says CFG2/CFG3 support 3.3 V or 5 V input.
findings.evidence: CH224 datasheet V2.0 s5.2.1, electrical table VIHI2C 1.5-3.3 V.
findings.reference_design: WCH reference uses MCU 3.3 V pull-ups.
findings.margin: 30 mV over the table, within the stated 5 V tolerance

findings.finding: RJ45 has integrated magnetics (1500 Vrms) but no TVS.
findings.reference_design: WT32-ETH01, Olimex ESP32-POE, LILYGO T-ETH: same.

round1_fixes_checked.how: POR and EN resets: yes (TCA9539 RESET=ESP_EN, R45 2.2k, YSO110TR tri-state, strap_check.py). Internal system reset (brownout reset enabled by REV_MIN=1, RWDT): no; firmware duty C1 not implemented. -> R3-DIGITAL-1
U17 is TCA9539 (no pull-ups); R40-R45 to GND on P00-P05 in core.net
board_core.c sub_start: I2S1 TX slave on GPIO2/4 with data on GPIO12
R67 10k + C47 1 uF: nRST 6.9 ms after OE vs 3 ms oscillator start
AUDIO_CONTROLS gpio36 debounce 40 ms in the patch
CH340B RST# internal pull-up per WCH V3D; pins 7/8/15 unconnected
R57 10k LCD_CS to GND; firmware comment stale (R3-DIGITAL-4)
hwde check_antenna on a /tmp copy: no copper under U7's antenna on any layer
justified disposition; still 2.25 mm side clearance (R3-DIGITAL-9)
